mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LOAN_PAYMENT ( LOAN_ID, SCHEDULE_ID, PAYMENT_DATE, TOTAL_AMOUNT, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT, INTEREST_AMOUNT, REMAINING_PRINCIPAL, PAYMENT_METHOD, PAYMENT_TYPE, MEMO, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{loanId}, #{scheduleId}, #{paymentDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{principalAmount}, #{interestAmount}, #{remainingPrincipal}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentType}, #{memo}, #{useYn}, NOW(), 'USER' )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TB_LOAN_PAYMENT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOAN_PAYMENT SET PAYMENT_DATE = #{paymentDate}, TOTAL_AMOUNT = #{totalAmount}, PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT = #{principalAmount}, INTEREST_AMOUNT = #{interestAmount}, REMAINING_PRINCIPAL = #{remainingPrincipal}, PAYMENT_METHOD = #{paymentMethod}, MEMO = #{memo}, UPDATED_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_BY = 'USER' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE TB_LOAN_PAYMENT SET USE_YN = 'N', UPDATED_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_BY = 'USER' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
